summary.text: Alex Ybarra is a Republican member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 13-Position 2 since January 14, 2019, and he is the candidate for Washington State Senate District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He began working at the Grant County Public Utilities Department in 2003.

paragraphs.text: Ybarra previously served as president of the Quincy School Board and was elected to the board of the Washington State School Directors Association.
He succeeded Matt Manweller (R) in the House in 2019.

In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Environment & Energy; College & Workforce Development; Joint Energy Supply & Energy Conservation; and Economic Development & International Relations committees.
Ybarra advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary for the Senate seat, which has no incumbent, and no other candidate is listed for the November ballot.
